_comment: Hand-authored island composition. Stage units are design pixels on the 1920x1080 canvas; origin is the centre of the island's walkable surface, y down. 'position' is where the layer's pivot lands. Pivots: bottom_center, top_center, center (of the asset's visible bounds) or [x, y] in source-image pixels.

character._comment: One scale for every form; bigger forms simply look bigger. form is the starting form until progression (Phase 6) sets it.

hud._comment: The hunger and sleep bars sit over this layer: centred on it, their top at the layer's top plus offset (stage units).

passthrough._comment: Clicks land on the outline of every layer plus a character box at every anchor, grown by padding (convex hull if the shapes do not join into one outline). Everything else passes through to the desktop.
